hypothesis: Estimating the expected future physical-assignment mismatch cost for matched sensor observation orders from prior PUBLIC anchor readings will generalize better than sensor-anomaly uncertainty value and improve compared with the strongest frozen fixed observation order.

method.observability: episode 0/1 public anchor calibration only before order decision at episode 3
method.action_space: all six temporal permutations of three fixed public nonanchor sensor pairs
method.training_support: each public-start value and action has matched training case support
method.sparsity: eight pseudo-observations empirical-Bayes backoff to global task cost; support below three cases uses global task value

gates.controls: all six constant observation orders; F9 best historical 66 mismatches
gates.success: requires prospective, independently cleared new cohort and meaningful superiority against best frozen control, not just fit to inspected F3
gates.negative: no improvement, poor generalization, undersupported action contexts or any safety violation; archive negative without after-test retuning
